limitations: Controlled fault-injection telemetry from five selected microservice cases, not organic production incidents or a representative benchmark.
Fifteen trials per condition repeat five cases; they are not fifteen independent incidents.
Human causal, mechanism-compatibility, privacy-impact, and completion review remains pending.
Official repository recording does not change the debug profile or confer production readiness.
Both conditions used schema finalization; no randomized prompt-versus-schema control was run. Historical protocol results must not be pooled.
Candidate service and finding scores preserve the saved extractor decisions, including metric-suffixed and broader attribution strings. No retrospective rescoring was performed.
The host exposes a model identifier, not an immutable backend build or provider-wire proof of constrained decoding.
The evaluated source included uncommitted changes. Hashes identify state but the base commit and publication alone do not enable complete replay.
Raw telemetry, prompts, model narratives and mechanism excerpts, captures, approvals, session IDs, local paths, private originals, and reveal links are excluded.
Source artifacts were redacted before replay. Replacement counts are disclosed; their causal impact and original-source retrieval remain unassessed.
Premium requests and cumulative totalNanoAiu are separate units; final session snapshots are summed once, including finalization.
